title: Thanks & anytime again
text: A great tour across the city. Thanks to our great tour guide Ronald, who presented his Barcelona to us with much joy and heart. We had a great time and say thank you, Tobias & Marga with Viktor and Oskar
author: Tobias_K

title: Pier, warmth, and electric bike—the perfect trio.
text: Our guide Pier was perfect! History, anecdotes, the tour was very interesting even for a 17-year-old teenager! ;)
author: Celia_P

title: A magical city told by a passionate and caring guide
text: We only had one day with our 2 children to visit Barcelona. The morning bike tour allowed us to target 1 or 2 places for the afternoon. Sergi, our guide made us love the city. His knowledge of the city’s history made us spend an unforgettable time. Even our 2 children, 9 and 12, have retained many anecdotes. Bravo Sergi
author: Fabrice_C

title: Fun day out in Barcelona!
text: Fun tour. Bikes were in good shape. Tour guide was knowledgeable and knew the city well. I saw a number of sites I hadn’t seen before that I wanted to check off my list. There may have been a few too many on the tour but still manageable. The check in person was super pleasant and even let me use her charger when my phone was dead. I would recommend this to anyone young or old for a fun day out in Barcelona!
author: Marvin_J

title: Exploring Barcelona by bike, super!
text: The venue and employees were good. They were kind and attentive. Clean local. Bikes in good condition. The guide is friendly and kind. I recommend announcing the route during the journey to anticipate the direction we will go. They did not take us to Las Ramblas, despite it being included in the itinerary. Thank you.
author: VivianJ_A

title: Instructive
text:
It was nice, too bad you book a special trip with a Dutch guide, and on arrival he speaks only English
Despite that setback, the guide tried very hard
